title: On Opposing the plan from the first day
subtitle: 国家公民 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）
meta: 主题语境：国家公民（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·国家与公民）　|　核心词汇：oppose　|　正文 354 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 oppose 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 the tailor ① opposed the plan from the first day in the rain, and every customer in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the tailor ② opposes the plan from the first day without complaint without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ oppose the plan from the first day at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ opposed the plan from the first day before — a line in the order for November 1952 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Opposing the plan from the first day in the rain, the tailor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the needle at the far mirror, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ oppose the decision in open court without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Oppose the decision in open court at once and never mention it again.

By 1965 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the order, and a new customer from the next shop ⑧ opposes the decision in open court in the rain every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the mirror, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ opposed the plan from the first day again when nobody else would.

⑩ To oppose the plan from the first day, my mother said in 1970, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the shop remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the shop forgets, somebody opposes the plan from the first day without complaint again and somebody must oppose the plan from the first day in the rain all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 反对（一般过去式 opposed the plan from the first day：1958 年裁缝头一回这样做，淋着雨）
B. v. 反对（一般现在 opposes the plan from the first day：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 反对（不定式 to oppose the plan from the first day：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 反对（过去完成时 had opposed the plan from the first day：1952 年十一月的订单簿上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 反对（动名词 opposing the plan from the first day 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 对抗（oppose the decision in open court：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去对抗在公堂上当众抗辩）
G. v. 对抗（oppose the decision in open court：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 反对（后段两处：新来的顾客照例 opposes the decision in open court，而母亲又一次 opposed the plan from the first day）

answers.why: oppose 意为“反对”，1958 年裁缝淋着雨反对从第一天起就反对那方案，那是裁缝铺里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 opposed。
oppose 意为“反对”，自那以后裁缝毫无怨言地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 opposes。
oppose 意为“反对”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯反对从第一天起就反对那方案”，此处为不定式 to oppose the plan from the first day。
oppose 意为“反对”，订单簿里 十一月 那行字说明早在 1965 年之前就有人反对过，故用过去完成时 had opposed。
oppose 意为“反对”，裁缝说“反对从第一天起就反对那方案这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 opposing the plan from the first day 作主语。
oppose 意为“对抗”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去对抗在公堂上当众抗辩”，should ever 之后用原形 oppose the decision in open court。
oppose 意为“对抗”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻对抗在公堂上当众抗辩（oppose the decision in open court at once），以后再也不要提起。
oppose 意为“反对”，新来的顾客每个星期都照例对抗在公堂上当众抗辩，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 opposes。
oppose 意为“反对”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次淋着雨反对从第一天起就反对那方案，用一般过去式 opposed 叙述。
oppose 意为“反对”，结尾那句是母亲 1970 年的话：要反对从第一天起就反对那方案，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和裁缝铺记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1958 年，裁缝淋着雨反对从第一天起就反对那方案；裁缝铺里每一个顾客都说这是头一回。（opposed the plan from the first day）
多年以后，裁缝仍毫无怨言地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（opposes the plan from the first day）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯反对从第一天起就反对那方案这件事本身。（to oppose the plan from the first day）
早在 1952 年就有人反对从第一天起就反对那方案，十一月那天订单簿上的一行字就是证据。（had opposed the plan from the first day）
裁缝说过，淋着雨反对从第一天起就反对那方案这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（opposing the plan from the first day 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻对抗在公堂上当众抗辩，以后再也不要提起。（oppose the decision in open court，祈使句）
answers: In 1958 the tailor opposed the plan from the first day in the rain, and every customer in the shop said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three weeks on, the tailor still opposes the plan from the first day without complaint without being asked.
My mother said later that to oppose the plan from the first day at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had opposed the plan from the first day long before 1965, and the line in the order for November proves it.
Opposing the plan from the first day in the rain, the tailor said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Oppose the decision in open court at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 oppose 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1958 the tailor opposed the plan from the first day in the rain, and nobody in the shop forgot it.
Even now the tailor opposes the plan from the first day without complaint whenever the shop asks.
Opposing the plan from the first day in the rain, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever oppose the decision in open court without complaint, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new customer from the next shop opposes the decision in open court in the rain every week, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother opposed the plan from the first day again, and the shop remembered that half.
